Barcelona EQ 1 copied from Real Madrid EQ 4 is visibly proved in the foreign preseason selector. BIGCAMP.PKF (80) and BIGESC.PKF (91) are mode-0 English-only stock surfaces.
surfaces.runtime_contract: A compiler may write only the existing three compact UI bitmap extents as one exact-shape transaction. Do not create foreign BIG* records or claim a distinct home/away or 3D kit until that separate render path has an in-game proof.

surfaces.storage: Unidentified continental draw candidate-pool membership contract; resolved fixtures reference existing EQ carriers, while no foreign domestic-table storage is exposed in an English-managed game
surfaces.scope: Foreign topology and continental competitions
surfaces.runtime_contract: Manchester United's live Round 2 draw resolves to existing EQ 2151 Valletta and consumes an indexed variable-length rename in both legs. A fresh trace confirms the loaded carrier before the draw and distinct generated fixture copies afterward. The apparent raw 2151-id sequence at 0x003dcf46 is Wine's mapped normnfc.nls Unicode-normalisation resource, not PM99 data or a club pool. This proves carrier identity consumption, not candidate-pool membership. Never infer a country or division field from record order, mode, a preseason picker, or a viewer grouping. Preserve foreign topology until the pool source and a safe membership-write proof exist.
